meta.name: process:mailbox
meta.description: 231 (plan stage C, C3d; DECISIONS 231): the download of a mailbox's new emails as a process pack (until C3d the wizard's mailbox form and the workflows' emails step kind): a case downloads its mailbox's emails into its package (an asynchronous fetch through the Outlook bridge, the worker's download job), a person starts its live run within the package's estimate, and the case is done once a live run is approved. A download no step takes (a scheduled one) wraps its package by a case too (the owner's decision of 2026-10-26).

changelog.note: 231 (U1e; the owner's decision of 2026-10-28): how its example material is tried: the invented consultancy's mailbox, read by the invented bridge instead of Outlook.
231 (U0): what the process is for, shown when a person picks a process to start a case of
231 (C3d): the first version: the document processing step with the mailbox maker (process_documents@1), its tabs Emails and History, and the workflows' emails step (workflow).

title: Emails from a mailbox
summary: A mailbox's new emails downloaded and read with their attachments: each email's intent and each attachment's type.

examples.note: Try it on the invented consultancy's mailbox, iroda@minta-tanacsado.example: its Inbox and Sent Items from 1 March to 31 October 2026 hold four invented emails (two invoices it sent, a payment notice, a quote request), read without Outlook.
